description: Points de repères des routes départementales en Maine-et-Loire is a dataset listed in Data.maine-et-loire.fr open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Département de Maine-et-Loire. Objets ponctuels localisant les points de repères (PR) du réseau routier départemental de Maine-et-Loire. Les PR sont des éléments essentiels en matière d'intervention, d'entretien, de secours, etc. Coverage: Maine-et-Loire. The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are route départementale, référentiel, déplacement. The portal shows 5,913 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-01-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-maine-et-loire-fr-portal.
